summary: difference over a statically analyzable set-like object using the receiver-scan branch.

semantics.path: iterate receiver; invoke known other.has with other as this; ToBoolean result

tests.name: truthy has result
tests.input: const o={size:5,has(v){return v===1?'yes':''},*keys(){}}; const a=new Set([1]); console.log([...a.difference(o)]);
tests.expected_behavior: has result is converted with JavaScript ToBoolean

tests.name: has this binding
tests.input: const o={size:5,tag:1,has(v){return this.tag===v},*keys(){}}; const a=new Set([1]); console.log([...a.difference(o)].length);
tests.expected_behavior: other.has is called with other as this
